10.2 MCI

GIFTs_functions_community %>%
  rowMeans() %>%
  as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(MCI = mean(value), sd = sd(value))%>% 
  mutate(MCI = str_c(round(MCI, 3), "±", round(sd, 3))) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(., "Species") %>% 
  select(MCI)
           MCI
Eb 0.362±0.038
Ha  0.35±0.078
Pk 0.368±0.048
MCI <- GIFTs_functions_community %>%
  rowMeans() %>%
  as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) 

shapiro.test(MCI$value)

    Shapiro-Wilk normality test

data:  MCI$value
W = 0.94256, p-value = 0.01558
results_aov <- aov(value ~ Species, data=MCI)
summary(results_aov)
            Df  Sum Sq  Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
Species      2 0.00332 0.001661   0.462  0.633
Residuals   48 0.17259 0.003596               
element_gift <- GIFTs_elements_community %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(., "sample") %>% 
  left_join(., sample_metadata[c(1,2)], by=join_by("sample"=="sample"))

uniqueGIFT_db<- unique(GIFT_db[c(2,4,5,6)]) %>% unite("Function",Function:Element, sep= "_", remove=FALSE)

significant_elements <- element_gift %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(sample,Species), names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(p_value = summary(aov(value ~ Species))[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]) %>%
  mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  filter(p_adjust < 0.05) %>%
  left_join(.,uniqueGIFT_db[c(1,3)],by = join_by(trait == Code_element))
element_gift_f <- GIFTs_elements_community %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(., "sample") %>% 
  left_join(., sample_metadata[c(1,2)], by=join_by("sample"=="sample")) %>% 
  filter(Species!="Ha")

uniqueGIFT_db<- unique(GIFT_db[c(2,4,5,6)]) %>% unite("Function",Function:Element, sep= "_", remove=FALSE)

significant_elements_f <- element_gift_f %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(sample,Species), names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(p_value = summary(aov(value ~ Species))[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]) %>%
  mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  filter(p_adjust < 0.05) %>%
  left_join(.,uniqueGIFT_db[c(1,3)],by = join_by(trait == Code_element))
